prompts.text: Name a wild mammal you could spot in Singapore
prompts.note: Wild animals only — no pets or zoo residents.

prompts.text: Name a reptile that lives in the wild in Singapore
prompts.note: Snakes, lizards, turtles and crocs. Common names are fine.

prompts.text: Name a bird you can spot in Singapore
prompts.note: Wild birds only — not pets or Bird Paradise residents.

prompts.text: Name a tree you'd commonly see in Singapore
prompts.note: Common or scientific names are fine. Palms count.

prompts.text: Name a flower or flowering plant you'd see in Singapore's parks and gardens
prompts.note: Orchids, shrubs, climbers and water plants all count.

prompts.text: Name a sea creature you might find on Singapore's shores or reefs
prompts.note: Animals only — not seaweed or seagrass. Broad names like 'crab' count.

prompts.text: Name a tropical fruit you can find in Singapore
prompts.note: Fruits grown here or in the region.
All 17 count. Upper and Lower are separate reservoirs.
